groups.reason: Positive, nonempty tag options narrow unboxed entity selectors to the smallest per-level tag bucket. Every result still passes the complete selector predicate and the live level lookup. Limited/ordered selectors fall back before evaluating predicates when more than one candidate exists, preserving random/stateful predicate evaluation on that path. Index membership follows tracking start/end and all mutations of the live Bukkit set, including bulk, iterator and load operations; the existing snapshot iteration and size limit remain intact. The index is maintained even while its query toggle is disabled so reload does not require a rebuild. This is not a claim of general cross-world selector thread safety.

ObserverBlock sends shape updates immediately after its native powered placement reset, before the original front-neighbor notifications. It rereads the current state and skips a replaced block. Native client, scheduled-tick and same-block gates remain unchanged. Independent native port of the source carpet-fixes behavior, default false.

TargetBlock sends shape updates immediately after its native powered placement reset using the current state only while the block is still a target. Native client, scheduled-tick and same-block gates and reset flags remain unchanged. Independent native port of the source carpet-fixes behavior, default false.

SpongeBlock optionally ORs UPDATE_NEIGHBORS into the existing wet-sponge write after successful absorption. Native breadth-first search, Purpur absorption controls, SpongeAbsorbEvent cancellation and snapshot application stay in place. Tests isolate the native event/snapshot-to-wet-sponge path. Independent native port of the source carpet-fixes behavior, default false.

NoteBlock initializes POWERED from the placement position after native instrument selection when the opt-in toggle is enabled. Paper's disable-noteblock-updates early return remains authoritative. Default remains false, matching the source carpet-fixes port.

FollowFlockLeaderGoal excludes existing leaders from recruitment before addFollowers applies its size limit. Existing follower filtering, leader selection, spawn rules and AI timing remain native. Default true matches the source FishNoStuck port; disabling restores the original recruitment behavior.

Ghast.faceMovementDirection retains heading below squared horizontal speed 0.01 only without an attack target. Both native callers, including HappyGhast's fallback look control, retain the source port's shared scope. Default true matches mc-ghast-direction port; target-facing and moving behavior remain native.

FilePackResources indexes non-directory ZIP entries once per open SharedZipFileAccess, shared by the primary pack and overlays. Prefix lookup preserves archive enumeration order, native invalid-path handling and closed-ZIP failures. Closing releases the index; reopening rebuilds against the new ZipFile. Native config toggle and integration regressions included.

Native NbtPath preclassifies compound-only paths of 2-32 nodes and reuses one mutable result list. Every read observes current tags, preserves missing-path errors and falls back to native traversal for a changed/branching node. Native config toggle and parity/mutation/fallback regression tests included.

26.3 CommandSourceStack.withEntity stores the shared NamesProvider.FOR_ENTITY. Both getters resolve entity names only when called, so native vanilla already supplies DPO's lazy-name behavior without sentinels or runtime weaving probes.
CubePointRange already precomputes a final reciprocal and multiplies in getDouble. Keep Gale's native implementation.
Leaf AttributeMap implements Consumer and passes this directly to supplier.createInstance after an indexed-map lookup. No per-call capturing lambda or extra factory cache is needed.

26.3 Enderman.teleport delegates to LivingEntity.randomTeleport, which checks hasChunkAt before reading ground blocks or calling canRandomlyTeleportTo. Preserve world-border clamping before that check.
Three immutable coordinate ranges are initialized before Moonrise's cache initialization and reused by getCoords; no lazy mutable cache or extra synchronization is needed.
CraftEntityType.minecraftToBukkit already uses a concurrent cache controlled by EnableCachedMTBEntityTypeConvert. Preserve the existing null/registry validation and native toggle.
All three native composter containers already return Gale/JettPack cached empty/zero-singleton int arrays, preserving the UP/DOWN face conditions.

Native TargetingConditions rejects candidates beyond maximumVisibilityDistance before getVisibilityPercent, including the new MobVisibility.MAX_VISIBILITY multiplier. Keep the current visibility/follow-range semantics.
Gale predicts Halloween start/end epochs in SpecialDates; do not stack DPO's hourly date cache over that native mechanism.
Profiler.get already returns InactiveProfiler.INSTANCE when LeafConstants.DISABLE_VANILLA_PROFILER is enabled. Retain that native control.
26.3 replaced SurfaceRules.SequenceRule with material.rule.SequenceRule. compile() builds a RuleEvaluator array; the hot traversal is an array loop, so there is no List iterator allocation to remove.

These target the removed 26.2 scalar NoiseChunk pipeline (BlockStateFiller/MaterialRuleList, wrap/wrapped, Cache2D.compute and preliminary-surface methods). The complete 26.3 NoiseChunk is now a DensitySamplerSet/DensityBufferPool volume owner. Preserve that new pipeline instead of resurrecting the removed scalar implementation.

ImprovedNoise and its double noise/sampleAndLerp interface were replaced in 26.3. Native PerlinNoise extends GradientNoise, uses float samples and already has Moonrise permutation/gradient acceleration. Do not transplant the 26.2 double interpolation formula into the new terrain pipeline.

DirtPathBlock became PathBlock in 26.3. The native fix checks the carried piston state only for DIRT_PATH, preserving other potential PathBlock variants, the fence-gate exception and missing-block-entity fallback. Includes a native config toggle and regression test.
Direct native implementations with Leaf configuration controls; diagnostic commands and remaining DPO modules are still pending.
The scheduler already uses Moonrise ReferenceList identity indexing with swap removal. Do not introduce another index.
EntitySelectorParser.getSelector already derives an AABB when distance has a maximum; retain the 26.3 native semantics.
Leaf Paw optimization already replaces the per-call direction values clones with Direction.VALUES in these target methods. MultifaceBlock's remaining static initializer is not a per-call clone.
ConnectionLazyExecuteMixin is a general Connection optimization, not a DivineMC-only target. Leaf already carries the upstream lazy non-flush patch and its native toggle.
Targets org.bxteam.divinemc.async.rct.RegionizedChunkTicking. TintedPaper does not contain that DivineMC subsystem; its parallel world/tracker implementation must retain its own ownership model.

Entity NBT is serialized through KeyFilterValueOutput so only the top-level keys the comparison names are encoded: @e[nbt=] (with the player SelectedItem skipped when the compared tag does not name it), EntityNbtPredicate (advancements, loot predicates and the predicate= selector option) and NbtPredicate.matches(Entity). Matching still uses NbtUtils.compareNbt on the filtered tag. NbtPredicate.matches verifies its first 500 results against the full serialization and turns partial matching off for the process on the first difference; the other two entry points keep native matching. The data get path-scoped variant, the discarded-preparation hooks and the /dpo status counters are not part of this port.
